Class ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.procedural.ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine
public class ManningStricklerHydrodynamicsEngine extends Object
Open-Channel River Hydrodynamics invalid input: '&' Floodplain Inundation Engine (Manning-Strickler Formula).

Models gravity-driven open-channel water flow velocity and volumetric discharge in river basins:

  • Manning-Strickler Mean Velocity Formula: $$v = \frac{1}{n} R_h^{2/3} S^{1/2} = K_{\text{strickler}} \cdot R_h^{2/3} \cdot S^{1/2} \quad [\text{m/s}]$$ where: - $n$: Manning roughness coefficient ($n \approx 0.030\text{ s}\cdot\text{m}^{-1/3}$ for natural clean channels). - $R_h$: Hydraulic radius ($R_h = A / P_{\text{wetted}} \approx \text{depth}$ in wide channels). - $S$: Channel bed hydraulic slope ($S = |\Delta z| / d$).
  • Volumetric Discharge ($Q$): $Q = v \cdot A \quad [\text{m}^3/\text{s}]$.
  • Floodplain Overtop invalid input: '&' Inundation: When discharge $Q > Q_{\text{bankfull}}$, water overtops natural levees, depositing fertile alluvial silt and replenishing soil moisture in riparian floodplains (Nile, Tigris-Euphrates, Indus).
